5612-6991-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
5612-6991-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Kudo, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Donnie & April token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2292-2317-5478-7084.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending Dwarven Mine.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Dwarven Mine.
When Dwarven Mine dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning Dwarven Mine from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking
When Dwarven Mine enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Dwarf creature token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-3249-3755-3841--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3249-3755-3841--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Elven Chorus by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Elven Chorus by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the creature castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature spell from your graveyard by paying it mana cost.
When you cast that creature or when it enters, Torens triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2558-5687-5689-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Skittering Precursor triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield as a 1/1 due to Raiders' Spoils, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Eldrazi Spawn.
Resolve the Evereth ability
Repeat.
2558-5687-5689-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

3476-3899-5145-5466.description:
Cast Rakdos Joins Up by paying {3}{B}{R}.
When Rakdos Joins Up enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phantatog by sacrificing Rakdos Joins Up.
Resolve the Rakdos Joins Up ability, returning Archon of Falling Stars from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it.
When Archon of Falling Stars enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Archon of Falling Stars.
Resolve the Archon of Falling Stars ability, returning Rakdos Joins Up from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

620-997-1429.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Lesser Masticore
When Lesser Masticore dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters, Yotian Dissident triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

2043-4885-7826.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Bag End Banquet that is a 1/1 Soldier in addition to its other types.
When the Bag End Banquet token enters, it triggers, creating three Food tokens.
Activate the Bag End Banquet token by tapping it, adding {C} for each Food you control.
Repeat
2043-4885-7826.notes: You can reduce the cost by up to {3} if you control additional Food(s) as you start the combo. You can also tap the original Bag End Banquet for mana after the Foods are created initially if you're able to do so.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

6568-7009-7803.manaNeeded: {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn available
6568-7009-7803.notablePrerequisites: Brad Boimler has been tapped this turn.
6568-7009-7803.description:
Activate Avatar Kuruk by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Y'shtola Rhul triggers, blinking Avatar Kuruk and causing it to return to the battlefield as The Legend of Kuruk with two lore counters on it due to Brad Boimler.
The Legend of Kuruk's first and second chapter abilities trigger, causing you to scry 2, draw a card, scry 2 and draw another card.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase. The Legend of Kuruk triggers, putting two lore counters on it. Its third chapter ability triggers, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat.

4428-4872-7757-7758.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that can attack and that cannot be blocked or killed by an opponent.
4428-4872-7757-7758.description:
Declare any creature as an attacker. When you do, Doom's Time Platform triggers, exiling Time Warp from your graveyard with two time counters on it.
Blink Shivan Sand-Mage using Thassa.
When Shivan Sand-Mage enters, it triggers, removing two time counters from Time Warp.
Time Warp's suspend ability triggers, causing you to cast it without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Time Warp, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

4970-5671-5751-7692.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one land card in hand.
4970-5671-5751-7692.description:
Cast Chromatic Sphere from your graveyard by paying {0} and discarding a land card from your hand.
Activate Chromatic Sphere by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1} and causing you to mill two cards and return a land card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

3967-7430--5.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability and Gorma trigger.
Resolve the Gorma trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Gorma.
Remove a +1/+1 and a -1/-1 counter from that creature as a state-based action.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat
3967-7430--5.notes: Each loop, Gorma will place an additional +1/+1 counter on the persist creature compared to the previous loop. This'll eventually result in both the persist creature and Gorma having infinite +1/+1 counters on them.

1479-2515-5621.notablePrerequisites: You have a Desert land card in hand or in your graveyard that enters the battlefield untapped.
1479-2515-5621.description:
Play Arid Archway from your hand or your graveyard.
When Arid Archway enters, it, Kodama and Hazezon trigger.
Resolve the Arid Archway trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting nothing from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Hazezon trigger, creating two 1/1 Sand Warrior creature tokens.
When the Sand Warriors enter, Kodama triggers twice.
Resolve the first Kodama trigger, putting nothing from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the second Kodama trigger from step 6, putting Arid Archway from your hand onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

147-997-7364.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-997-7364.description:
Cast Continue? by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Continue?.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Continue?
Resolve the Continue? copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
147-997-7364.notes: You can sacrifice up to three additional creatures and return them using Continue? each loop.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any additional creature without summoning sickness you control

requires.n: Permanent with Landfall Ability: Create Creature Token(s)

573-872-3259--85--106.notablePrerequisites: An opponent is unable to block and kill creatures you control.
573-872-3259--85--106.description:
Activate Scaled Herbalist by tapping it, putting Gruul Turf from your hand onto the battlefield.
Gruul Turf enters the battlefield, triggering itself and the permanent with a landfall ability.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the landfall trigger, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage to an opponent with the creature that has Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to and then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token from step 4, untap all creatures you control, and get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1796-1824-2530-7350.easyPrerequisites: You have not completed Tomb of Annihilation, nor are currently venturing in it.
1796-1824-2530-7350.description:
Cast Acererak by paying {B}.
Demon's Horn triggers, causing you to gain life.
When Acererak enters, its first ability and Carnival of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Resolve the Acererak trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand, and venturing into Lost Mine of Phandelver.
Repeat.

6738-7011-7082-7296.easyPrerequisites: You control three or more Allies.
6738-7011-7082-7296.description:
Cast Razor Boomerang by paying {0} due to Sokka, Swordmaster.
When Razor Boomerang enters, Sokka and Suki's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When the Ally enters, Sokka and Suki's first ability triggers, attaching Razor Boomerang to the Ally token.
Activate the Ally token by tapping it and unattaching Razor Boomerang, dealing 1 damage to any target and returning Razor Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2440-2703-4460.description:
Activate Myr Propagator by paying {3} and tapping it, creating a token copy of it.
When the Myr Propagator token enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Myr you control.
Repeat using the Myr Propagator token instead.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-3968-7297.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-3968-7297.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Grave Titan as attackers.
Grave Titan triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

997-1765-5972.notablePrerequisites:
You control an Aura that is attached to another creature you control.
You control at least one additional creature beyond the creature that has the Aura attached.
997-1765-5972.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing another creature that has an Aura attached to it.
When the creature dies, Cass triggers, returning an Aura that was attached to the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
When the Aura enters the battlefield, Chishiro triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

3175-3605-4812-5686.description:
Cast Animate Dead by paying {1}{B}.
When Animate Dead enters, it trigger, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching Animate Dead to it.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, targeting Dance of the Dead.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Sun Titan.
Resolve the Sun Titan trigger, returning Dance of the Dead from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dance of the Dead enters, it trigger, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching Dance of the Dead to it.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, targeting Animate Dead.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Sun Titan.
Resolve the Sun Titan trigger, returning Animate Dead from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2438-3678-7084.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Retreat to Emeria triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

1400-4619-5147.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1400-4619-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Teysa triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token that is black due to Darkest Hour.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

1661-2854-3200-4574.easyPrerequisites: Showdown of the Skalds' second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
1661-2854-3200-4574.description:
Cast Urza's Bauble either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}
Showdown of the Skalds triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Activate Urza's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Urza's Bauble from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

648-6744.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 3.
648-6744.notablePrerequisites: Susur Secundi has twelve or more charge counters on it.
648-6744.description:
Cast Body of Research by paying {G}{G}{G}{U}{U}{U}, creating a 0/0 Fractal creature token and then putting a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to your deck size.
Activate Susur Secundi by paying {1}{B}, tapping it, paying 2 life and sacrificing the Fractal token, causing you to draw cards equal to its power. This will cause you to draw your entire library.

2035-4067-5632.easyPrerequisites:
You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {B}.
You control an additional creature.
2035-4067-5632.description:
Activate a permanent by tapping it, adding at least {B}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Gollum, untapping the permanent.
Activate Gollum by paying {B} and sacrificing a creature, returning Gollum from your graveyard to your hand.
Chalk Outline triggers, creating a creature token and a Clue token.
Repeat.

3129-3951-4192-5703.easyPrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr
3129-3951-4192-5703.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker, triggering its ability, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it and creating two tapped and attacking copies of Éomer.
Put all but one Éomer token into your graveyard due to the legend rule, causing you to get at least one Éomer trigger, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, Altaïr triggers, causing you to exile the Éomer token.
Repeat each combat phase.

1399-1606-3457-4249.easyPrerequisites:
Ley Weaver does not have summoning sickness
Seeker of Skybreak does not have summoning sickness.
1399-1606-3457-4249.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to green is at least 4.
1399-1606-3457-4249.description:
Activate Nykthos by paying {2} and tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Seeker of Skybreak.
Activate Seeker of Skybreak by tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat.

372-2239-4598.notablePrerequisites:
You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Essence Flux exiled by Abdel Adrian.
Ardent Elementalist exiled by Abdel Adrian.
You have enough mana to cast Essence Flux.
372-2239-4598.description:
Cast Essence Flux by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Ardent Elementalist and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Ardent Elementalist trigger.
Resolve the Ardent Elementalist trigger, returning Essence Flux from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Essence Flux.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Ardent Elementalist and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: with a takeover counter on it

1430-1912-3719-5326.notablePrerequisites: Mirror Image has a power of at least 2.
1430-1912-3719-5326.description:
Cast The Master by paying {U}{B}.
When The Master enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Mirror Image and create at least two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate The Master by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning Mirror Image from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of The Master, which causes the Mirror Image to be a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When Mirror Image enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice The Master and create two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Mirror Image by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning The Master from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

4812-5145-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Archon of Falling Stars, adding {R}.
When Archon of Falling Stars dies, it triggers, returning Animate Dead from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Animate Dead enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Archon of Falling Stars from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Animate Dead to it.
Repeat.

1992-4050-4981.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
1992-4050-4981.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature with a +1/+1 counter on it, adding one mana of any color.
The creature dies, triggering Basri's Lieutenant's second ability, creating a 2/2 Knight creature token.
When the Knight enters the battlefield, Serra Redeemer triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on the Knight.
Repeat.

224-539-4096.notablePrerequisites:
Goblin Welder does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one nontoken artifact creature.
You have at least one artifact creature card in your graveyard.
224-539-4096.description:
Activate Goblin Welder by tapping it, sacrificing any artifact creature you control and returning any other artifact creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
The creature enters the battlefield as a Forest land, triggering Retreat to Coralhelm, untapping Goblin Welder.
Repeat.

1486-4222-4474.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real and Paradise Mantle attached to Magda.
Magda does not have summoning sickness.
1486-4222-4474.description:
Activate Magda by tapping it, adding {U}.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Magda.
Repeat for infinite Treasure tokens.
Once you have infinite Treasure tokens, you can use them to activate Magda's ability to put all artifacts and Dragons in your library onto the battlefield.

1414-2173-2854-4574.easyPrerequisites: Showdown of the Skalds' second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
1414-2173-2854-4574.description:
Cast Lotus Petal either from your hand by paying {0} or from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Showdown of the Skalds triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Lotus Petal from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

224-765-3177.description:
Activate Sakura-Tribe Scout by tapping it, putting Guildless Commons from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Guildless Commons enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Guildless Commons trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Sakura-Tribe Scout.
Repeat.
